description: This file defines an abstract class 'TransportConnection' that extends 'ConnectionContext' for handling network connections, including properties for connection endpoints, identifiers, features, memory pool, transport channels, and methods for connection management such as aborting the connection.

classes.name: TransportConnection
classes.description: An abstract class managing network transport connections, providing properties and methods for connection identification, features, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: TransportConnection()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the connection with a fast reset.

methods.name: Abort(ConnectionAbortedException abortReason)
methods.description: Overrides the base method to cancel pending reads on the application input pipeline to abort the connection.
